budget_items.what_was_recorded: As of October 8 the school building project was on schedule and a bit under budget; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: as of the october 8 school building committee meeting the project is pretty much on schedule and a bit under budget.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Aerial fly-overs documenting the project cost a stated amount per flight; the committee is attentive to cost control.
budget_items.quote: aerial fly-overs to document this major project and which will cost $450 per flight will take 40-50 photos.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The FY 2015 capital appropriation for asbestos abatement was insufficient given the bids; no work has taken place in FY2015 and an alternate seven-year approach has been developed.
budget_items.quote: the fy 2015 capital appropriation of $138,000 for asbestos abatement in specific areas of the middle school was insufficient to cover costs in light of the bids that were submitted.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Joint discussion planned to structure borrowing to minimize total financing costs; no figure printed.
budget_items.quote: the purpose is to determine how to structure the borrowing to minimize total costs of financing the project given projected cash flow and estimated total costs.
